asignatura: INICIACIÓN A HABILIDADES COMUNICATIVAS EN INGLÉS(B)
resumen:
Writing is one of the most important skills: it leaves a lasting record and mistakes are immediately evident (p. 14).
Poor writing can lower marks or make people judge you as lazy or untrustworthy (p. 14).
Strategy use transfers: strong writers in L1 tend to be strong in English (p. 14).
Writing works by translating ideas into language, revising wording and correcting errors (p. 15; slide 3).
Top tips: mind-map, outline, touch-type, revise, checkers, productive vocabulary, read, text types; basic structure connectors (p. 15-17).

conceptos.definicion: Reading is a receptive skill that requires an individual to make meaning from the language input to which they are exposed. In writing, learners must actually create meaning and produce their own language.
conceptos.fuente: HABILIDADES COMUNICATIVAS EN INGLÉS COURSEPACK.pdf (Canvas 75868, file 8319191), p. 15

conceptos.definicion: Most English language learners have a larger receptive vocabulary than a productive one. This means you may understand a word when you see it but it won't necessarily show up in your writing.
conceptos.fuente: HABILIDADES COMUNICATIVAS EN INGLÉS COURSEPACK.pdf (Canvas 75868, file 8319191), p. 16

conceptos.definicion: if you are a strong writer in your first language, chances are you will also be a strong writer in English. That's because strategy use transfers.
conceptos.fuente: HABILIDADES COMUNICATIVAS EN INGLÉS COURSEPACK.pdf (Canvas 75868, file 8319191), p. 14
